PLANESWALKER-SOL_RING.title: Sol Ring
PLANESWALKER-SOL_RING.description: At the start of each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
PLANESWALKER-SOL_RING.flavor: A ring forged from a fragment of a sun. Every planeswalker wants one; few are willing to say why.
PLANESWALKER-CHROMATIC_LANTERN.title: Chromatic Lantern
PLANESWALKER-CHROMATIC_LANTERN.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Mana}[/blue] mana of [gold]every[/gold] color.
PLANESWALKER-CHROMATIC_LANTERN.flavor: Its light reveals every color of mana at once.
PLANESWALKER-SENSEIS_DIVING_TOP.title: Sensei's Divining Top
PLANESWALKER-SENSEIS_DIVING_TOP.descript: At the start of your turn, [gold]Scry[/gold] [blue]{Scry}[/blue].
PLANESWALKER-SENSEIS_DIVING_TOP.flavor: Spin it, and the future rearranges itself to suit you.
